programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: 100 Days of Love
programme.desc: Despite their strained history as children, a columnist falls in love with his schoolmate when they meet after years. Just as he decides to win her heart, he learns that she is engaged to another man.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Daring Ashique
programme.desc: Cheenu, a studious boy, and Lakshmi, the village landlord's daughter, study in the same college and fall for each other. However, her brother-in-law covets her and poses problems for the couple.

programme.title: Johny I Love You
programme.desc: Suraj Singh, a former bandit, relocates to a small hillside after the death of his wife, Savitri. He changes his son Raju's name to Johny to save him from the wrath of his former partner.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Baadshah
programme.desc: Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Viduthalai Part 1
programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.title: Ohm Shanti Oshaana
programme.desc: Pooja Mathew, a spirited young girl, dreams about marrying only for love. Thus, she stops at nothing to impress Giri, who saved her once from a group of unruly men.

programme.title: Khatarnak Khel
programme.desc: A young girl loses her parents in an accident due to illegal bike racers in Chennai. She soon sets out to exact revenge on the racer responsible for her parents' death.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Chak De Phatte Hockey Ke..
programme.desc: Prabhakaran, a former hockey player, helps a local team save their ground by training them to win a match against the Pondicherry team. However, a corrupt politician has his eyes set on the ground.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Main Hun Ziddi
programme.desc: Bollywood action starring Prajwal Devaraj, 2013.

programme.title: Mithya
programme.desc: Albert Samson, a successful architect, and Alice are leading an unhappy married life because of Samson's ambitious and egoistic nature. Hilda Varghese enters Samson's life and changes it completely.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne
programme.desc: Jai, an unemployed drunk, gives false testimony that puts an innocent man in jail for murder. However, he later relents and tries to exonerate him by searching for the real killer.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Mr. Natwarlal
programme.desc: When Natwar's elder brother is framed for bribery, he decides to avenge his brother's humiliation and thus poses as a crime lord.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Madrangi
programme.desc: Deepu, the daughter of a rich businessman, falls in love with her driver Manu. Problems arise when Manu suffers a brain injury and is blamed for the death of an MLA's brother.

programme.title: Azad Desh Ka Andha Kanoon
programme.desc: A brash and honest policeman is torn apart between his duties and saving his family when his own brother is caught in a blue-film scam. He also must protect a sole witness whose life is in danger.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer shares a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. When he tries to collect evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Khakee: The Real Police
programme.desc: When a drug lord ransoms police officer Diwakar's son for a bag of cocaine, he has no choice but to steal it from police headquarters. However, this raises the suspicions of his colleague Mallika.

programme.title: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: In an attempt to fulfill their dreams, three friends get entangled in trouble related to a director's death. Meanwhile, they confront an inspector while trying to save themselves.

programme.title: Illaka
programme.desc: Raja and Suman, two sons of a labour leader, choose different professions in their life after facing numerous difficulties from childhood to adulthood.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Solid Hits
programme.desc: Songs which have topped the charts & ruled your hearts, the biggest hits of the recent times.

programme.title: Chalte Chalte
programme.desc: Geeta is admitted to a mental hospital after her lover passes away tragically. Later, she gains her senses, only to find him alive and in love with another woman.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: Kalyug Ka Pandav
programme.desc: A man falls in love with a woman, who unfortunately refuses to marry him due to a dark family secret. In response, his brothers devise a plan to unite the two lovers.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: An inspector gets suspended for his irascible behaviour. The situation worsens when he gets framed for the murder of an ex-politician's son and must prove his innocence.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes
programme.desc: ACP Malvika Chauhan, a widowed mother, is assigned to investigate the murder of a businessman. However, she suspects it to be a serial killer as more murders take place in the city.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
programme.desc: 2/15. Horticulturist Christine Walkden visits the Beth Chatto Gardens and RHS Hyde Hall, and boards a vintage Thames sailing barge for a trip on the Blackwater Estuary.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: How do you protect Britain's busiest mountain when more than 600,000 people visit each year? Charlotte Smith and Joe Crowley head to Yr Wyddfa to meet the people caring for its landscape.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: 19/26. Dougie is in Morvern to see the rare Irish cattle returning to Scotland after centuries.

programme.title: Best of Weatherman Walking: Northern Nostalgia
programme.desc: 6/10. Derek takes a dip in a glacial lake at Cadair Idris, and visits Portmeirion and Llangollen.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt serves up a riot of flavour with dishes from Bryn Williams, Julie Lin and Poppy O'Toole. Meanwhile, Rick Stein and the Hairy Bikers head out of the studio.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: 4/8. Eva and her Breton guide Tanguy Thomassin explore the vast oyster beds of Cancale, oyster capital of Brittany.

programme.title: Moose in the Glen
programme.desc: 10/15. Wildlife documentary about landowner Paul Lister, who wants to turn his 23,000-acre estate north of Inverness into Europe's first wilderness reserve.

programme.title: Gymnastics: World Championships 2026
programme.desc: Coverage of the second part of the apparatus finals from Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: 6/8. The team are at Gloucester Cathedral, where presenter Paul Martin and experts Phillip Serrell and Michael Baggott examine the antiques and collectibles brought in by the public.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: 2/5. From the road trip archives, music legends Peter Andre, Martin Kemp and Sinitta swap the studio for the saleroom, vying to be top of the pops. But who will get the number one spot?

programme.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: 4/4. Simon Reeve embarks on a 3,000-mile journey across the deserts, plains and mountains of Mongolia in search of snow leopards and the nomadic people who hunt with golden eagles.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: 5/8. Sitting between Germany and France, Alsace is frontier land with a cuisine to match, showcasing very German sausages and very French frogs' legs.

programme.title: The Balkans: Europe's Forgotten Frontier
programme.desc: 2/2. Katya Adler travels to Romania, Kosovo and Serbia.

programme.title: New: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: 1/6. Paul and Bob fish the River Ribble in Lancashire and are joined by Ted for the last time.

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: 1/6. Hollywood legend Bill Murray's journey gets underway, from golf in County Cork to chance encounters in Kinsale. Unexpected detours lead to a few surprises along the way.

programme.title: Later with Jools Holland
programme.desc: 3/6. Jools welcomes Dexys Midnight Runners, Courtney Barnett, Madra Salach, Ibibio Sound Machine, Mulaa Joans and Elkie Brooks to the show.

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: A nurse's devotion towards an author injured in a car accident takes a sinister turn. Contains some strong language and some violent scenes.

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of topical debate.

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: 5/6. Lee is embarrassed to be seen at an alternative craft fair where Lucy is trying to sell her badly made dream catchers. Contains adult humour.

programme.title: Ellie & Natasia
programme.desc: 1/3. Ellie White and Natasia Demetriou make a chaotic return to the screen, with a guest appearance from Steve Coogan. Contains some strong language and adult humour.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Two parent-and-daughter duos dash with their cash around a bustling antiques fair in Kent, searching for collectibles to sell at auction.

programme.title: The Great House Revival
programme.desc: 4/4. Hugh meets designers Robin and Eoin on their journey to convert a Victorian schoolhouse into a chic family home.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys

programme.title: Madagascar: Earth's Tropical Islands
programme.desc: 1/3. Exploring the unique wildlife of Madagascar, the oldest island on earth.

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow

programme.title: Mastermind

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: Crashes: Explores the 10 most significant air crashes and train accidents, uncovering the tragic events that captured global attention and impacted countless lives. (2 of 9) 7+

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Pilot Under Pressure: Looks at the circumstances surrounding the crash of SilkAir Flight 185 in 1997, which suddenly plunged 35,000 feet over Indonesia, killing 104 people. 7+

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: Maybachs and Meds: CBP officers track suspected smuggling operations on land and sea, from a stolen luxury vehicle to suspicious vessels and modified cars. (S1, ep 9) 7+

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Revenant Skeleton, Spy Cam, Shakespearean Mangle: Why is a skeleton found with a blade across its stomach, a stone on its neck and a strange green colour in its mouth? (S3, ep 6) 7+

programme.title: Abandoned Megastructures
programme.desc: Vermont Marble Factory: The guys search the factory where marble was made for the US Supreme Court. They also find White House blueprints in an old bomb shelter. (S1, ep 12) 7+

programme.title: Made In A Day
programme.desc: Electric Cars: Tesla in Fremont, California, share electrifying insights into one of the most iconic electric cars - the Model 3. (S1, ep 1) 7+

programme.title: Made In A Day
programme.desc: Electric Guitars: Gibson Guitars in Nashville, Tennessee, spill the beans on how they make their iconic instruments. (S1, ep 2) 7+

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Warhol Soup: Discover how Campbell's spells out the letters for perfect soup. And, why is dry ice crucial to making sweet and sticky brioche? (S1, ep 5) 7+

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: The Big Apple: Discover why nimble fingers are crucial in making perfect spanakopita. And what exactly adds a whole year of shelf life to a box of sweet apple juice? (S1, ep 6) 7+

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo
programme.desc: Giraffe Goals: Everyone at the Columbus Zoo is waiting for the first baby giraffe to be born in over 20 years. (S1, ep 4) 7+

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin suspects his neighbour is responsible for a recent heist in 'What A Gem', and in 'Family Spirit', Alvin tries to get out of the family picnic with Dave to go to a soccer game. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel in 'Simon the Superb', then in 'The Sub', Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after school music class. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore gets stuck taking care of Miss Croner's cats in 'The Cat Sitter', then in 'Addicted', The Chipettes challenge the Chipmunks to go three hours without their favourite things. (S3, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's job in 'Adventures in Babysitting', then in 'Alvin's Assistant', Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant but ends up running errands instead. (S4, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin almost drives a local toy store out of business in 'Unboxing Day', then in 'Dave's Pavillion', Dave's new pavilion is surprisingly ruined for some reason. But who is to blame? (S5, ep 2)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave's old high school visits in 'The Dinner', then in 'The Tour', The Chipmunks can't wait to go on a World tour until Theodore and Alvin realize what they'll be leaving behind. (S5, ep 26)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin tells Theodore that he can turn rubbish into sweets in 'Alvin's Secret Powers', then in 'Warbie', The Chipmunks find a baby bird that's fallen from its nest. (S1, ep 24)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds in 'Jeanette's Secret Garden', then in 'Treasure Hunt', the Chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure. (S2, ep 22)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Turf War: Needing to find a part time job to buy the latest video game, Alvin decides to "borrow" Brittany's baby-sitting job. But Basil is not too thrilled at having Alvin look after him! (S1, ep 18)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Time Capsule: When the school digs up an old high school time capsule, Miss Smith and Dave work together to keep an old secret. (S4, ep 8b)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Last Day of Summer: Alvin wastes his entire summer playing a video game then tries to do all the fun things he'd planned in one day. (S4, ep 21a)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Gone Gal: When Miss Croner has a disagreement with Miss Miller, she fakes her disappearance to get even. (S5, ep 8a)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon's experiments cause trouble when Dave asks him to declutter in 'Pack Animal', then in 'The Haunted Getaway', the boys face a haunted cabin. (S3, ep 21)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin sneaks into Simon's new virtual reality game in 'The Chosen Chipmunk', then in 'Double Dangus', Officer Dangus has a twin brother that's a bully, which will not do. (S4, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave enforces strict study rules after Alvin blames him for bad grades in 'Alvin Gets Schooled', then in 'My Life As a Dog', Theodore acts as a dog. (S5, ep 19)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin convinces Dave to give him his own room in 'A Room of One's Own', then in 'Carts and Crafts', Alvin inadvertently destroys Theodore's bicycle, so enters a contest to win a new bike. (S1, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipettes set out to prove that being a superhero isn't just a guy thing in 'Super Girls', then in 'Held Back', Alvin must pass his next test, or be separated from his brothers. (S2, ep 15)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave struggles on a hike with the Chipettes in 'Girls Night Out', then in 'Tables Turned', Alvin's prank on Simon backfires. (S3, ep 14)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in 'Artsy Smartsy', then in 'The Crush', Simon has a crush on the babysitter and secretly prepares a romantic dinner. (S4, ep 13)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon moves into a tree for some alone time in 'Back To Basics', then in 'Report Cards', Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything to catch the mail before Dave sees it. (S3, ep 2)

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Vanished Detective. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. Sherlock Holmes disappears, urging Dr. Watson and Inspector Lestrade to find him.

programme.title: The Painted Smile

programme.title: Wanted For Murder

programme.title: The Price of Silence
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Director: Montgomery Tully. Stars Gordon Jackson, June Thorburn & Mary Clare. Roger forges a new life for himself after his release from prison. But his past catches up with him.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Black Brothers. 1959. Stars Conrad Phillips, Roger Delgado & Warren Mitchell. Three Italian bandits steal arms intended for the Swiss resistance and then attempt to sell them to William Tell.

programme.title: The English Riviera
programme.desc: 1958. Produced and directed by Harold Baim. A magnificent short film touring the beauty spots, historical buildings and resorts within the county of Devon, also known as the English Riviera.

programme.title: Brad Pitt: More Than a Pretty Face
programme.desc: 2022. Director: Adrien Denouette, Thibaut Seve. Dive into the brain of a complex, brilliant and endearing personality, far from the cliche of a world famous movie icon.

programme.title: Last Holiday
programme.desc: 1950. Drama. Directed by Henry Cass. Stars Alec Guinness, Beatrice Campbell & Kay Walsh. A salesman who learns he has months to live cashes in his savings to live in a fancy hotel.

programme.title: Doctor In Distress
programme.desc: 1963. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, James Robertson Justice & Samantha Eggar. Dr. Simon Sparrow's love life improves when the lovely Delia Mallory is brought into casualty.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: 1964. English rock and pop band The Hollies perform the wonderful hit Little Lover.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Yukon Affair. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & George Sanders. G. Emory Partridge returns with a plot to disrupt world communications. Solo and Illya travel to Alaska to stop him.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Roy Ward Baker. Stars: Robert Ryan, Rhonda Fleming & William Lundigan. A tough business man is left to die with broken leg in the desert by his scheming wife and her lover.

programme.title: Maxwell
programme.desc: 2007. Drama. Director: Colin Barr. Stars David Suchet, Patricia Hodge & Ben Caplan. The final two months of the life of media tycoon Robert Maxwell, as his life is on the brink of collapse.

programme.title: The Lolo Ferrari Story
programme.desc: 2000. An insightful documentary about the life, career and tragic death of French entertainer and dancer Lolo Ferrari, a cultural icon who became the subject of heavy media exploitation.

programme.title: The Silent Partner
programme.desc: 1978. Thriller. Director: Daryl Duke. Stars: Elliott Gould, Susannah York, Christopher Plummer, John Candy. A bank teller skims $50,000 during a robbery, but the crook wants it back.

programme.title: The Wild Ride
programme.desc: 1960. Director: Harvey Berman. Stars Jack Nicholson, Georgianna Carter & Robert Bean. A rebellious punk spends his days partying and troublemaking until life catches up with him.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: John Ford is known for his visually powerful westerns with his characters framed against America's stunning natural landmarks. His four Academy Awards for Best Director remain a record.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Zelda the Great. 1966. Stars Adam West, Barbara Heller & Anne Baxter. Batman and Robin match wits and escape techniques with Zelda the Great and her fiendish master.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: A Death Worse Than Fate. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Anne Baxter. Zelda is forced to lure Batman and Robin into a possibly unsolvable deathtrap, with hitmen waiting outside if they escape.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Careless Suffragette. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. A member of parliament is killed after a suffragette has her croquet ball bomb stolen.

programme.title: Piccadilly Third Stop

programme.title: Gaolbreak
programme.desc: 1962. Directed by Francis Searle and starring Peter Reynolds, Avice Landon and David Kernan. A mother and her two sons run a newsagents as a front for their criminal activity.

programme.title: Indiscretion of an American Wife
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Directed by Vittorio De Sica. Stars Jennifer Jones, Montgomery Clift & Richard Beymer. A married woman gets into an affair in Rome and is torn between her old life and new romance.

programme.title: Faces in the Dark
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Directed by David Eady. Starring John Gregson, Mai Zetterling & John Ireland. Richard, a factory owner, becomes blind during an experiment on the very day his wife wants a divorce.

programme.title: Dial 999

programme.title: The Buccaneers

programme.title: The Child and the Killer

programme.title: Look At Life Men In The Mode
programme.desc: 1961. A look into the story of the male fashion world and how it is slowly moving toward gaiety and decoration.

programme.title: A Nice Little Bank That Should Be Robbed

programme.title: Melody

programme.title: Out of Town

programme.title: Dick Turpin

programme.title: Van der Valk

programme.title: Nights of Cabiria
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Director: Federico Fellini. Stars Giulietta, Francois Perier & Franca Marzi. A waifish prostitute only finds heartbreak while wandering the streets of Rome in search for love.

programme.title: Bob & Carol & Ted & Alice

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Mechanical Watchman. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, John Howlett & Peter Allenby. Maguire catches a fur coat thief in the act; however, the other members of the gang remain unknown.

programme.title: Stagecoach West

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: A Riddle a Day Keeps the Riddler Away. 1966. Stars Adam West, Frank Gorshin & Susan Silo. Batman and Robin try to outsmart the Riddler in a wicked plot to take over the city by kidnapping a king.

programme.title: Batman

programme.desc: The Case of the Reluctant Carpenter. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. Sherlock is against the clock to locate a bomb hidden in London by an extortionist.

programme.title: Love from a Stranger

programme.title: The Snows of Kilimanjaro
programme.desc: 1952. Romance. Directed by Henry King & Roy Ward Baker. Stars Gregory Peck & Susan Hayward. A writer reflects on his life as he lies dying from an infection while on safari near Mount Kilimanjaro.

programme.title: Fools Rush In
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Victor H. Komow. Stars Frank Silvera, Ken Buckridge & Jean Alexander. A ship with a cargo full of diamonds gets taken over by pirates.

programme.title: Screenagers! - Glimpses

programme.title: Up In The World

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street

programme.title: The Thirty Nine Steps (1978)

programme.title: Music Hall
